periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, approximately 45 degrees downward slope from the posterior corner toward the anterior muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop shape, more oval than circular with an approximate 1.8:1 height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant tapering at the lower margin, creating a large vertical distance between the geometric center and the lowest ventral point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band occupying approximately 30% of the visible torso span in profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, roughly twice the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular convex curvature at the top boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible open-mouth vocalization/yawning posture revealing teeth and tongue; distinct brownish-orange staining on the lower posterior and flank fur.
